summary: Mag 7 earnings dominated this week, with all four reporting hyperscalers raising AI capex guidance and cloud results beating across the board — Google Cloud up 63% year over year, well ahead of estimates. Meanwhile, the Fed held rates steady in what was likely Powell's final meeting, with policymakers still gridlocked between persistent above-target inflation driven by tariffs and energy prices and a softening growth backdrop.
tweet: Mag 7 hyperscalers all raised AI capex and Google Cloud surged 63% — but the Fed is frozen, with tariff-driven inflation keeping cuts off the table.
